Seek concrete contradictions, missing obligations, hidden semantic restrictions, evidence-authority confusion, and unjustified implementation or compatibility claims. Do not assume access to governing source documents absent from the packet. When a conclusion requires unavailable evidence, report the limitation explicitly. Cite exact source lines for findings. A favorable review is not product-owner acceptance or authorization to implement, publish, or merge.
mission.objective: Independently examine the non-normative requester-owned review mission proposal in PR #45 for internal coherence, coverage of the stated Issue #44 design requirements, preservation of Review Broker technical responsibilities, historical compatibility, and unsupported claims.

findings.claim: D5 misattributes requested substantive evidence to the agent rather than the requester and combines supplied and produced evidence, despite D1 assigning substantive-evidence ownership to the requester and the examples requiring producer claims to be separated from independently observed facts.
findings.consequence: A successor contract following D5 could obscure who set an evidence requirement and whether evidence was merely supplied or independently observed, defeating the required evidence-authority separation.
